title: A warmer welcome. A better way to find your files.
summary: A little guidance to get connected, and a few useful tools once you’re there.

changes.title: A guided first connection
changes.text: New iPhone setup walks you through getting the Mac app ready and finding your Mac, then hands over to the familiar scan-and-confirm pairing screens. Skip it any time; paired users go straight to their Macs.

changes.title: Find the file you came for
changes.text: Search filenames in the current Mac folder, filter by file type, and sort by name, date modified or size. Folders stay first, and a reset gets you back to the full listing.

changes.title: A little help, when you need it
changes.text: Your first connection offers a dismissible touch and keyboard guide. Setup and controls help are also available in Settings. Download errors keep your file browser in place.

changes.title: Get the iPhone app before pairing
changes.text: Mac onboarding now includes a TestFlight QR code, an Open button and a copyable link. The installation code is separate from the private pairing code that follows.
